key_findings: prjxray-derived all_cells shapes are a SOUND SUPERSET on V7: 0 spurious bits across all 976 variants (no measured PIP bit falls outside the predicted window).
81% of measured (family,src) match the prjxray shape EXACTLY; the rest are SUBSET explained by differential-measurement blindness (predicted bit already 1 in ref), NOT shape errors.
